thread:
incident-bot: Pager: gpu-pool-us-east1 saturated (95% queue growth). autoscaler failing to add nodes, multiple 503s observed from hosted-api. priority: P1. @Alice oncall.

Alice: Ack. I'm on it.

Alice: Quick check — are we seeing quota errors or slow provisioning?

Ravi: hitting `quotaExceeded` in the autoscaler logs, looks like cloud GPU quota for the project is at limit. autoscaler attempted 4x scale, all failed. snippet: ```2026-03-15T12:07:02Z ERROR autoscaler: create_instance failed: quotaExceeded: GPUs per project reached```

Mei: we're also seeing queue depth climb on the request router, TTLs bumping and some requests dropping to 502/503. telemetry: 15m p95 token latency doubled.

Carlos: routing layer reports spillover attempts to eu-west1 but the route-engine is throttling failover because model variant mismatch (fp16->int8 fallback) for some customer routes.

Priyanka: tagging customer-impact: several mid-market tenants see errors on model-generation endpoints, support tickets incoming. need rapid mitigation to reduce error surface.

Alice: Steps: 1) confirm autoscaler failure reason (Ravi) 2) assess safe cross-region spillover (Mei/Carlos) 3) apply temporary circuit-breaker to reduce acceptance of new long-running requests (Amanda) 4) notify customers via status (Priyanka).

Ravi: confirmed: autoscaler retries failed due to `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: GPUs` and also `limitExceeded` from quota API. No node provisioning errors beyond quota.

Amanda: preparing a temporary `circuit-breaker` rule to cap inflight tokens per route. will deploy a conservative limit to buy time.

Alice: Mei/Carlos — can the router divert new traffic to eu-west1/asia while preserving model compatibility? we need to avoid variants that change output shape.

Mei: Router can steer by model tag. We have `model-v2-int8` and `model-v2-fp16` pools. Some customers pinned to fp16 only. For those, eu-west1 has fp16 capacity but cold-start latency will be higher. We can steer non-pinned traffic immediately.

Carlos: Initiating gradual spillover for unpinned traffic: `route-engine spillover --from us-east1 --to eu-west1 --percentage 30 --mode gradual` (internal command). Monitoring logs.

ops-bot: Spillover job started: id=spill-26321-1. watch: /ops/spillover/26321-1

Priyanka: Posting customer advisory draft to status page: short ETA and mitigation steps. tagging impacted customers via support.

Alice: Amanda — deploy circuit-breaker now, push 503 early for extremely long tails rather than letting requests pile.

Amanda: deployed CB v1. Rule: if inflight_tokens > 1500 then reject new requests for route `/v1/generate`. pushing to prod in 30s.

incident-bot: CB deployment succeeded.

Ravi: Just received confirmation from cloud quota team: emergency quota increase request submitted, but approval time unknown. Will open support case for expedited review.

Mei: From router metrics: after 30m, spillover 30% reduced queue growth by ~40% p95 latency down somewhat. However eu-west1 cold-starts caused some 504s initially.

Carlos: We're seeing a small routing flapping with sticky sessions — some sessions pinned to us-east1 still failing. Recommend enabling cookie-agnostic spillover for affected routes to allow session migration.

Alice: Go for it, but add a 1h TTL so we can revert if downstream issues appear.

Carlos: cookie-agnostic spillover enabled for target routes with TTL=3600s.

Priyanka: Notifying customers update #2: spillover in effect, circuit-breaker active, degraded latency for pinned customers. Asking impacted customers to retry after a few minutes.

Amanda: Note: we had one manual scale attempt that succeeded for a small pool (gpu-pool-aux) but overall capacity still short of demand.

Ravi: action items: 1) follow up with cloud quota escalation (Ravi) 2) post-incident runbook updates for autoscaler quota failure (Alice) 3) verify model-variant parity across regions to avoid future mismatch (Mei) 4) improve routing fallback to prefer compatible variants when possible (Carlos). I'll own cloud ticket.

Alice: Handoff: I'm staying on for next 30m to ensure stabilization, then hand to Ravi for follow-up. Amanda will watch circuit-breaker metrics, Priyanka will keep customers updated.

Mei: after 55m, queue stabilized and 5xxs trending down. still elevated latencies for pinned routes.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged resolved (operationally degraded -> stable) at 2026-03-15T12:18:00Z.

Alice: Will create postmortem draft with timeline, root cause (GPU quota exhaustion + autoscaler not handling quota soft-fail), mitigation (circuit-breaker + cross-region spillover + cookie-agnostic fallback), and follow-ups. Assigning owners: runbook (Alice), quota automation (Ravi), variant parity audit (Mei), routing improvements (Carlos), customer comms wrap (Priyanka).

Priyanka: thanks everyone — will close status once customers confirm improved behavior. :thumbsup:

Carlos: small note for postmortem: add metrics link and the spillover job id (spill-26321-1) and the autoscaler logs snippet.

Alice: Closing thread for now. Leave watchers on the follow-up issues.
